# Swimming

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Movement](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Swimming)*

While you're swimming, each foot of movement costs 1 extra foot (2 extra feet in [Difficult Terrain](Difficult-Terrain.md)). You ignore this extra cost if you have a [Swim Speed](Swim-Speed.md) and use it to swim. At the DM's option, moving any distance in rough water might require a successful DC 15 Strength ([Athletics](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/free-rules/playing-the-game#Skills)) check.
